meta.description: Documents why news sources have high error counts and are unreachable

ME.name: Middle East Region
ME.reason: Government-level internet filtering and DNS blocking
ME.recommendation: Accept as operational cost; requires local infrastructure to circumvent

SO.name: Somalia
SO.reason: Government internet restrictions, limited infrastructure, intermittent connectivity
SO.recommendation: Keep marked but accept as expected failure; low likelihood of recovery

AF.name: Afghanistan
AF.reason: Taliban government restrictions on media, blocking of foreign news services
AF.recommendation: Accept as operational cost; most western news blocked

EA.name: East Africa Region
EA.reason: Government-level internet restrictions, limited press freedom
EA.recommendation: Keep marked but accept as expected failure

UZ.name: Uzbekistan
UZ.reason: Government filtering of foreign news and social media

PH.name: Philippines - Defunct
PH.reason: ABS-CBN and other major networks shut down by government decree
PH.recommendation: Mark as defunct; periodic recheck only

LB.name: Lebanon - Media Restrictions
LB.reason: Economic crisis affecting media viability, some outlet restrictions
LB.recommendation: Mark as potentially defunct; recheck quarterly

SV.name: El Salvador
SV.reason: Press freedom concerns under current government

VE.name: Venezuela
VE.reason: Government blocking of independent media, social media restrictions
VE.recommendation: Accept as expected failure; limited press freedom

XX.name: Unknown/Multinational
XX.reason: Sources that don't map to a specific country; often international aggregators
XX.recommendation: Review individually; may include blocked multinational sources

unreachable.description: Network-level blocking or DNS resolution failure
unreachable.action: Accept as expected; cannot be fixed without local infrastructure

allowed_but_failing.description: Robots.txt allows access but fetch still fails
allowed_but_failing.action: Reduce poll frequency for these sources

never_succeeded.action: Mark as active=false after 30 days of no success
never_succeeded.rationale: These were likely never viable sources; don't waste resources rechecking

intermittent.action: Increase poll_interval_s to reduce load (try 3600s or higher)
intermittent.rationale: They work sometimes; don't overwhelm them when they do

regional_blocks.action: Accept error_count growth as operational cost
regional_blocks.rationale: Cannot circumvent government-level blocking without local infrastructure
